subject: chemistry
title: Molecules: Atoms Bonded
welcome_lead: Two or more atoms holding hands chemically: you've just met a molecule.
meta_desc: Discover molecules in this KS3 chemistry adventure on atoms bonded together.
final_note: You now know the difference between an atom and a molecule.

concepts.def: Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.
Force holding atoms together in a molecule.
Molecule of just two atoms, like O₂.
Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Same atoms bonded together (e.g. H₂, O₂).

walkthroughs.body_html:
A molecule is two or more atoms chemically bonded together. The atoms may be the same or different.

2+ atoms = molecule.

O₂ — two oxygen atoms (the air you breathe).
H₂O — two hydrogen + one oxygen (water).
CO₂ — one carbon + two oxygen (the gas you breathe out).

N₂, H₂, Cl₂ are also diatomic.

If the atoms in the molecule are the same element (like O₂), it's still an element.

If the atoms are different elements (like H₂O), it's a compound.

What does an NMR chemical shift (δ, in ppm) actually measure?
options: Chemical shift is the mass of the molecule divided by 1000.
Chemical shift is the absolute resonance frequency of the nucleus in Hz.
The position of a peak RELATIVE to TMS (tetramethylsilane, δ = 0), normalised by the spectrometer frequency.
The colour changes because the new ligand is itself coloured.

mcqs.q: Why does the colour of a transition metal complex change when ligands are exchanged?
options: The colour changes because the new ligand is itself coloured.
Different ligands cause different amounts of d-orbital splitting, so different wavelengths of light are absorbed.
The colour changes because the metal ion itself changes oxidation state.
Chemical shift is the mass of the molecule divided by 1000.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Diatomic”?
options: Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Molecule of just two atoms, like O₂.
Force holding atoms together in a molecule.
Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Compound molecule”?
options: Different atoms bonded together (e.g. H₂O).
Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Molecule of just two atoms, like O₂.
Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Molecule”?
options: Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.
Molecule of just two atoms, like O₂.
Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Force holding atoms together in a molecule.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Element molecule”?
options: Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Molecule of just two atoms, like O₂.
Different atoms bonded together (e.g. H₂O).
Same atoms bonded together (e.g. H₂, O₂).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Triatomic”?
options: Force holding atoms together in a molecule.
Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Molecule of just two atoms, like O₂.
Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Bond”?
options: Molecule of three atoms, like H₂O or CO₂.
Different atoms bonded together (e.g. H₂O).
Force holding atoms together in a molecule.
Two or more atoms chemically bonded together.
